extracted.name: Butternut Squash with Apple and Cranberries
extracted.description: This hearty butternut squash recipe with fresh apples and tart cranberries has all the warmth of fall wrapped into a seasonally delicious dish.
ingredient_lines: 1 (1- 3/4) pound butternut squash, cut into 1/2-inch cubes
0.25 cup I Can't Believe It's Not Butter!® Spread, melted
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees F (218 degrees C).
Combine squash, apple, cranberries, melted spread, brown sugar, cinnamon, and nutmeg in a 1 1/2-quart baking dish. Stir until well combined and cover the dish.
Bake in the preheated oven for 30 minutes. Uncover and continue baking until squash is tender, about 15 more minutes.
